name: WF-459 — Seller Counteroffer → Underwriting Recalculation, MAO Protection & Negotiation Decision Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const counterofferId=String(b.counterofferId??b.responseId??'').trim(); const counteroffer=Number(b.counteroffer??b.counterofferAmount??0); return [{json:{...b,leadId,portfolioId,dealId,counterofferId,counteroffer,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Counteroffer Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const arv=num(ctx.arv??ctx.ARV); const repairs=num(ctx.repairs??ctx.repairEstimate); const contingency=Math.max(0,num(ctx.repairContingencyPercent??10)); const closingCosts=num(ctx.closingCosts); const holdingCosts=num(ctx.holdingCosts); const wholesaleCosts=num(ctx.wholesaleCosts); const protectedMao=num(ctx.protectedMAO??ctx.protectedMao); const currentOffer=num(ctx.currentOffer); const sellerMotivation=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,num(ctx.motivationScore??50))); const risk=String(ctx.riskLevel??'medium').toLowerCase(); const repairContingency=repairs*(contingency/100); const allCosts=repairs+repairContingency+closingCosts+holdingCosts+wholesaleCosts; const conventionalMao=arv*0.70-allCosts; const investorMarginMao=arv*0.72-allCosts; const calculatedMao=Math.max(0,Math.min(conventionalMao,investorMarginMao)); const canonicalProtectedMao=protectedMao>0?protectedMao:Math.max(0,calculatedMao); const offer=counteroffer(input); function counteroffer(x){return Number(x.counteroffer)||0;} const gap=offer-currentOffer; const gapToMao=canonicalProtectedMao-offer; const utilization=canonicalProtectedMao>0?offer/canonicalProtectedMao:1; const profitAtCounter=arv-allCosts-offer; const blocked=ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true||['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(ctx.dealStatus??'').toLowerCase()); const flags=[]; if(blocked)flags.push('protected_or_blocked_deal'); if(offer<=0)flags.push('invalid_counteroffer'); if(canonicalProtectedMao<=0)flags.push('missing_protected_mao'); if(offer>canonicalProtectedMao)flags.push('counteroffer_above_protected_mao'); if(profitAtCounter<0)flags.push('negative_projected_profit'); if(risk==='high'||risk==='critical')flags.push('elevated_deal_risk'); let decision='human_review'; let nextAction='review_counteroffer'; if(blocked)decision='blocked'; else if(offer<=0||canonicalProtectedMao<=0)decision='human_review'; else if(offer<=canonicalProtectedMao && profitAtCounter>=0){ if(offer<=currentOffer){decision='accept_or_contract';nextAction='move_to_contract_readiness';} else if(offer<=canonicalProtectedMao*0.97){decision='controlled_concession';nextAction='counter_with_protected_concession';} else if(offer<=canonicalProtectedMao){decision='accept_or_contract';nextAction='accept_or_finalize_within_mao';} } else if(offer>canonicalProtectedMao){decision='reprice_or_walk_away';nextAction=sellerMotivation>=70?'restate_value_and_reengage':'walk_away_or_nurture';} const confidence=blocked||flags.includes('missing_protected_mao')?25:flags.length>=3?55:90; const idempotencyKey='wf459:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.counterofferId; return [{json:{...input,underwriting:{arv,repairs,repairContingency,closingCosts,holdingCosts,wholesaleCosts,totalCosts:allCosts,conventionalMao,investorMarginMao,calculatedMao,protectedMAO:canonicalProtectedMao,currentOffer,counteroffer:offer,negotiationGap:gap,gapToProtectedMAO:gapToMao,maoutilization:utilization,projectedProfitAtCounter:profitAtCounter,sellerMotivation,riskLevel:risk,decision,nextAction,flags,confidenceScore:confidence,requiresHumanReview:decision==='human_review'||risk==='high'||risk==='critical'},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, portfolioId, dealId and counterofferId are required'} }}

meta.notes: Recalculates deal economics when a seller counteroffer arrives, preserves the canonical protected MAO ceiling, evaluates projected profit and risk, and routes the counteroffer to accept/contract, controlled concession, reprice/walk-away or human review. Production use requires a canonical InsulaCRM MAO source, validated underwriting assumptions, accounting definitions and production API contracts.
